function [M1,M2,M3,M4]  = fcn(t,r, p, y)
2
M1 = t - 0.707107*r + 0.707107*p + y;
3
M2 = t + 0.707107*r - 0.707107*p + y;
4
M3 = t + 0.707107*r + 0.707107*p - y;
5
M4 = t - 0.707107*r - 0.707107*p - y;

10
end
